beats.text: You fixed one answer. Three others broke.
One small prompt change, and your A.I. got worse. Would you catch it?
Fix found: prompt foo. An exam for your A.I. app.
You write test questions, and what a good answer must contain.
One command runs them on every model and marks each answer pass or fail, side by side.
Change a prompt, run it again, and you see what broke before your customers do.

And the free version caps red teaming and sharing.
